question: State the important properties of the normal distribution.
sources: Normal distribution (standard theory of probability distributions)

points.label: Shape and symmetry
points.description: The normal curve is bell-shaped and symmetrical about the mean, so mean, median and mode are equal and skewness is zero.

points.label: Parameters and area
points.description: It is a continuous distribution fully described by two parameters, the mean (μ) and the standard deviation (σ); the total area under the curve is 1.
points.basis: Normal distribution: parameters and total probability

points.label: Tails and inflexion
points.description: The curve never touches the horizontal axis (it is asymptotic to it), and its points of inflexion are at μ − σ and μ + σ.
points.basis: Normal distribution: asymptotic tails and points of inflexion

points.label: Area within limits
points.description: About 68.27% of the area lies within μ ± σ, about 95.45% within μ ± 2σ and about 99.73% within μ ± 3σ.

points.label: Other measures
points.description: Quartile deviation is about 0.6745σ (roughly two-thirds of σ) and mean deviation about 0.7979σ (roughly four-fifths of σ); the quartiles are equidistant from the median.
points.basis: Normal distribution: relation of quartile deviation and mean deviation to σ
